defect: The empty-input branch now keys on grouping_set.empty() per grouping set but still assumes the output chunk holds only aggregate columns, so an empty grouping set next to non-empty ones on an empty table violates the assert and indexes op.aggregates past its end instead of emitting NULL group columns.
reason: Before the change the condition was op-level groups.empty(), where the chunk really had no group columns; the per-grouping-set condition introduced here is what makes the fixed branch wrong, and the same diff shows GetData handling chunks with group columns.

defect: PyGenericAlias::check_ does py::module::import("types").attr("GenericAlias"), which raises AttributeError on Python versions before 3.9 that DuckDB still supported, so every isinstance check throws.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this newly added inline check with an import-cache lookup that tolerates a missing attribute, just as the UnionType check had been fixed for 3.9 the day after.

defect: The early-out rewrite of the drive-designator test calls PathMatched(path, sub_path) instead of PathMatched(path_aux, sub_path), so Windows paths that start with a drive letter are no longer recognised as absolute.
reason: The original code used path_aux; the change switched to the wrong variable and the fix restores path_aux on the same line.

defect: In the new forward-scan branch, a non-negative offset with a negative length that leaves end < start (e.g. offset 0, length -1 gives start 0, end -1) is not treated as empty, so the whole rest of the string is returned.
reason: The removed SubstringStartEnd path handled this case; the rewritten branch only checks end == 0, and the fix adds the missing end <= start check to that line.

defect: The fix declares n_children as idx_t and drops the (void) cast to repair a signed/unsigned comparison in the loop condition.
reason: This change looped with an explicit (idx_t) cast; blame shows the uncast comparison 'i < n_children' came from c840cc97 (2024-01-26) and the (void) line from 5f401a6, both later commits.

defect: The new index_scan_function only fetches row ids from the base table and never scans transaction-local storage, so rows appended in the current transaction are missing from index-scan results.
reason: The removed DataTable::IndexScan (data_table.cpp) also scanned transaction.storage after the index; the fix adds that local storage scan back into the new index scan function.

defect: The fix unwraps LogicalFilter operators above the target LogicalGet before casting, for joins whose single-sided predicates become filters.
reason: The direct Cast<LogicalGet>() on the join child already existed before this change, which only walked down single-child operators to find the join, so the filter-on-target crash was pre-existing.

defect: On Windows, PathSeparator only treats the prefix 'file:/' as a URL, so joining onto 'file:' (how the change's own no-host test builds its URLs) yields a backslash separator and the new file:/ tests fail on Windows.
reason: The Windows CI failure comes from the file:/ support added here, and the fix widens exactly this changed line to 'file:'; seeing it needs the new test in test_file_system.cpp.

defect: The fix changes 'return art;' to 'return std::move(art);' in the create_instance lambda to silence a clang-tidy warning.
reason: The fix is labelled and scoped as a tidy-warning cleanup; the branch compiled, so it is a style fix, not a repaired defect.

defect: unbound_expressions.reserve(art.unbound_expressions) passes a vector instead of its size, which does not compile.
reason: The line was added by this change and the 'Fix build error' commit changes it to reserve(art.unbound_expressions.size()).

defect: The fix makes GetEdges skip filters whose left and right relation sets are identical, to recover cardinality-estimation and plan-quality regressions on the join-order branch.
reason: This change's edits to this file only switch filter_info.set from a reference to a pointer; the fix is an estimator heuristic tied to the wider WIP branch, not a defect in these lines.

defect: The fix casts index + i to int64_t in a test REQUIRE to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: This is a warning fix in test code, which the instructions count as a test or style change.

defect: The new in-loop check 'if (!exceptions.empty())' and 'throw Exception(exceptions[0])' read the shared exceptions vector without executor_lock while other threads push errors into it, which is a data race.
reason: The unlocked read inside the execution loop was added by this change, and the fix replaces it with a locked GetError helper.

defect: The fix adds DESCRIBE to the set of keywords after which table names are suggested (issue 6182).
reason: DESCRIBE was never a table-name keyword, before or after this change, so this is a feature gap, not a defect introduced here.

defect: The fix deletes a leftover debugging line 'auto break_here = "sadfg";' from a work-in-progress commit.
reason: An unused debug variable has no functional effect; removing it is cleanup.

defect: The fix changes Value::MAP and Value::EMPTYLIST to take the LogicalType child_type by const reference.
reason: This is a clang-tidy performance/style fix with no behaviour change.

defect: The fix makes WindowNaiveAggregator::CanAggregate return false, not true, when wexpr.aggregate is null.
reason: Its only callers are in WindowAggregateExecutor, which is built only for WINDOW_AGGREGATE expressions that always carry an aggregate, so the null case is unreachable and the fix only tightens the guard.

defect: The fix makes strict-mode integer and double parsing reject leading zeros (issues 5782 and 5794).
reason: This change only restructured the hex/binary/negative control flow; leading zeros were accepted before it as well, so the fix adds new behaviour.

defect: The fix corrects string-to-MAP splitting (NULL keys, empty maps) and try-cast handling.
reason: This change only added struct splitting; the SplitStringMap and HandleKey code the fix repairs was added by later commits.

defect: The fix merges the two LHS fetch branches so an exhausted LHS is fetched once and returns, and drops Normalify.
reason: The redundant second GetChunk on an exhausted LHS was already there before this change (the old code fetched at the end of the call and again at the start), and the compile error this change caused was fixed by an earlier commit, so the fix is a simplification.

defect: The new ResultCollectorIsBlocked returns false as soon as any to-be-rescheduled task is not a pipeline task blocked on its sink, so a blocked result collector next to other blocked tasks never returns RESULT_READY and execution loops forever.
reason: The function was added by this change, and the fix turns its early 'return false' exits into 'continue' so that one blocked result-collector task is enough; seeing the hang needs the task and sink-blocking semantics in other files.

defect: The fix moves the inline BufferEvictionNode and getter definitions out of the new header into buffer_pool.cpp and reshuffles includes to fix compile errors.
reason: This header looks compilable on its own (all used types come in through its includes), and the errors may instead come from later code-move commits or the master merge on the branch; I could not settle which without building.

defect: The fix moves the NeighborSubset class out of this file and switches to Begin/End/Size iteration for clang-tidy naming rules.
reason: This is a tidy and refactor change with no defect repaired.

defect: The fix changes the format specifier for the integer HTTP status in the ListObjectV2 error message from %s to %d.
reason: The wrong '%s' with response.status was already in the call before this change, which only switched the HTTPException constructor arguments.

defect: The fix copies user_type_name and enum_type_name instead of holding references into 'type', which dangle after type is reassigned and is then used in the system-catalog fallback.
reason: In this change the reference is only used before type is overwritten; blame shows the use-after-free fallback lookups were added by d907438 the next day.

defect: The fix changes the scheduling declarations (event_map_t, ScheduleUnionPipeline taking a parent pipeline) to keep UNION ALL output order deterministic.
reason: This change is a pure reformatting of the declarations; the ordering bug lies in the union scheduling logic, not in anything this commit changed.

defect: The fix chains union pipelines so that each depends on the previous one, giving deterministic UNION ALL output (issue 2599).
reason: ScheduleUnionPipeline and the union-pipeline scheduling the fix changes did not exist in this change, which only restructured the event map and event ownership.

defect: The fix reinitialises the existing validity and child scan states instead of pushing new child states onto state.child_states.
reason: The push_back of new child states was already there before this change; this change only added 'start +' to the child offset, which the fix keeps.

defect: The new indented Node::ToString prepends indentation to prefix nodes although Prefix::ToString (added in prefix.cpp in the same commit) already indents, so prefixes are printed double-indented.
reason: The faulty extra indentation loop was added by this change, and the fix removes it; seeing the double indent needs prefix.cpp.

defect: The fix makes BlockSink take its BlockedSink by const reference.
reason: This is a clang-tidy parameter-passing fix with no behaviour change.

defect: The fix renames the constructor parameter to data and std::moves it into buffered_data.
reason: The mem-initializer buffered_data(buffered_data) was correct (it reads the parameter); the change is a tidy cleanup.

defect: The fix sets the physical plan's estimated_cardinality from estimated_props->GetCardinality() instead of op.estimated_cardinality.
reason: At this commit the join order optimizer sets op.estimated_cardinality (with has_estimated_cardinality) and estimated_props from the same JoinNode, so the two values agree up to clamping and the fix only changes the source of the number.

defect: Switching join_nodes_in_full_plan from set strings to JoinNode pointers makes the check join_nodes_in_full_plan.count(new_plan.get()) always false, because new_plan was just allocated; must_update_full_plan is never set and the use-after-free guard for updated full-plan nodes is disabled.
reason: The pointer-identity lookup was introduced here, and the fix restores string-based tracking of the full-plan node sets.

defect: The fix renames the debug-only accessor GetDependenciesVerification to GetParentsVerification and returns it by const reference.
reason: At this commit the accessor returned parents_raw and its caller used it consistently, so the header change is an API rename and refactor, not a defect fix.

defect: In the rewritten CreateChildPipeline, the new loop that copies operators up to 'op' is immediately overwritten by the leftover 'child_pipeline->operators = current->operators;', so child pipelines get the wrong operator list.
reason: This change set source = op, dropped pop_back and added the copy loop but kept the full assignment, and the fix deletes that stale line; it also corrects the event ordering and total_pipelines count introduced by the same refactor.

defect: The fix handles abs_value == UINT64_MAX in the byte-size computation, adds a uhugeint cast, sets the zero data byte, and removes commented-out memsets.
reason: At this commit IntToVarInt took only int32_t, so UINT64_MAX could not occur; the templated version, the zero branch and the commented code the fix touches came from later commits.

defect: The new guard in Normalize tests 'done > 0.0' before dividing by total instead of 'total > 0.0', so total == 0 with done > 0 divides by zero, and ProgressDone, whose clamping this change removed, now returns inf.
reason: The guard was added by this change with the wrong variable, and the same-day fix changes it to total > 0.0.

defect: The fix removes the FilterInputsChangeTypes declaration because the check was rewritten as a static helper in the .cpp.
reason: The header line only changed the helper's signature (it is called with a copy of the filter); removing the declaration is a refactor, and the logic fix lives in pushdown_projection.cpp.

defect: The fix replaces FilterInputsChangeTypes with ProjectionCastsToLowerType, which compares the column type with the projection expression type before allowing pushdown.
reason: At this commit FilterInputsChangeTypes was defined but never called (PushdownProjection checked only volatility), so it changed no behaviour; the logic the fix replaces was wired in by f1375bb.

defect: The new StringAggLong benchmark ends with FINISH_BENCHMARK(StringAggShort), duplicating the StringAggShort registration and leaving StringAggLong unregistered, which breaks the benchmark build.
reason: The copy-paste error is in lines this change added, and the fix changes it to FINISH_BENCHMARK(StringAggLong).
